; dual-rM link indicator in the library's status tray (left of the sync / WiFi / battery icons): a link
; icon and "USB" / "WiFi" while linked. The state lives in MainView's dualrmLink item (dualrm.qmd, set
; by the "link" command), found by walking up the parents (MainView is an ancestor of the navigator).
; A file of its own so that a firmware with a different header cannot stop dualrm.qmd from loading.
; "?#indicatorRow" finds the tray row at any depth by its id: the header's root type differs by
; firmware (3.29: FocusScope, 3.23: DeviceKeyboardNavigationHandler), the row does not.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/ContentHeader.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#indicatorRow
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
        INSERT {
            Row {
                id: dualrmLinkTray
                property var src: null
                visible: src !== null && src.via !== ""
                spacing: 4
                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignVCenter
                function dualrmFind() {
                    for (let p = dualrmLinkTray.parent; p; p = p.parent) {
                        const kids = p.children;
                        for (let i = 0; i < kids.length; i++) {
                            if (kids[i].objectName === "dualrmLink") {
                                dualrmLinkTray.src = kids[i];
                                return;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Component.onCompleted: dualrmFind()
                Timer {
                    interval: 1000
                    repeat: true
                    running: dualrmLinkTray.src === null
                    onTriggered: dualrmLinkTray.dualrmFind()
                }
                ArkControls.Icon {
                    size: ArkControls.Values.iconSize.small
                    source: "qrc:/ark/icons/link"
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                }
                Text {
                    text: dualrmLinkTray.src && dualrmLinkTray.src.via === "usb" ? "USB" : "WiFi"
                    font.pixelSize: 24
                    color: "black"
                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
